scope: Shipped main.js startServer/onUnload with real Express, HTTP, HTTPS, TLS certificate validation, authenticated routes and PWA assets; actual onReady control flow with downstream subsystem initialization observed at explicit call-tracing boundaries; controller/certificate retrieval and device writes are local doubles.
limitations: No browser rendering or installed-PWA acceptance test.
No real controller certificate store, customer credentials, deployment or hardware.
The onReady checks prove initialization reachability and shutdown ordering, not EMS or hardware control cycles.
Temporary generated CA and private keys were deleted and are never included in this report.
